gre_general.value: MSE no longer requires GRE General scores.
gre_general.quote: MSE no longer requires the Graduate Record Exam (GRE) general test scores of graduate applicants.

gre_subject.value: There is no GRE Subject test for materials science and the pages do not mention one.

supervisor.value: Not stated for the PhD; funding depends on matching with an advisor after admission.

funding.value: Graduate assistantships with a tuition waiver and stipend are available to admitted PhD students who match with an advisor; MS students are usually unfunded.
funding.quote: Financial aid in the form of Graduate Assistantships is available to students admitted to our PhD graduate program who match with an advisor. The Assistantships will include a tuition waiver and will provide a competitive stipend.

entry_route.value: Applicants with a BS and/or MS in materials science or a related science/engineering field can be admitted; MSE recruits mainly students who will stay for the PhD.
entry_route.quote: Students with a BS or/and MS degree in Materials Science and Engineering, Polymer Science and Engineering, Ceramic Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Textile Engineering, Chemistry, Biomedical Engineering, Biology, Physics, or in a related field of science and engineering can be admitted in the graduate program.

notes: MSE may grant a limited number of department fee waivers, preferring strong PhD applicants with financial need (email inquire@mse.gatech.edu at least 10 business days before submitting). Transfer students are not accepted.
